1.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported on board
1.summary: Thousands of sailors on the Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

2.title: 'I shot Mr Thompson' - Inside the court as Mangione pleaded guilty
2.summary: BBC's North America correspondent Nada Tawfik was in the courtroom as Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty.

3.title: Russell Fry Backs Darline Graham in South Carolina Senate Runoff Amid Trump Pressure
3.summary: The president has been focused on the race since the death of Lindsey Graham in July. Ms. Graham, the late senator’s sister, is competing against Representative Ralph Norman in a runoff on Aug. 25.

4.title: Kevin Rideout, American Missionary Kidnapped in Niger, Is Released
4.summary: Kevin Rideout, a pilot, was abducted from his home in the country’s capital, Niamey, last fall. His mission organization said he was in “good health” after his release.

5.title: Zambia vote counting resumes after pause over alleged attacks on polling staff
5.summary: The electoral commission said violence had "resulted in the theft of marked ballot papers".

6.title: As Europe Gets Hotter, Its Transportation Systems Struggle to Cope
6.summary: The continent’s railways and roads “were engineered for a climate that no longer exists,” one expert said.
